messages:
Cam: Heads-up: planning to flip on `route_by_cost_v2` for 10% of traffic tomorrow 9am PT. Need a dead-man switch and telemetry gates. Thoughts?
Mira: Agree. Need quick metrics: error-rate, p50/p95 latency, cost-per-token. Suggest adding tag `config.rollout=route_by_cost_v2` to events so dashboards can filter.
Jasper: We already emit `config.rollout.*` events from the runtime but they're not wired to alerts. Can we reuse the existing `rollout-guard` alert policy? :thinking_face:
Lex: Proposal: dead-man switch = automatic rollback if error-rate > 1.5% or p95 latency increases >30% vs baseline within a 5min window. Also abort if request availability < 99%.
Tara: Make thresholds configurable per-customer tier. Dedicated customers should have stricter SLOs and manual approval before auto-rollback.
Cam: How do we wire this into Console? Ideally one-click rollback on rollout page + a 'snooze' button for noisy infra. Also need a timeline of checks in the UI.
Mira: Also add sampling traces with `trace:rollout=route_by_cost_v2` so traces in Stackdriver/Tempo show the decision path. And add a structured log line on apply: `CONFIG_APPLY route_by_cost_v2 user=rollout-bot`.
Jasper: Edge-case: flag touches routing policy + quota evaluation. Need to invalidate route cache and per-route quota tokens in the same transaction. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/422
deploy-bot: Dry-run check results: `route_by_cost_v2` -> 0 regressions on eval set, latency delta +2%. Runbook: 
```
# rollback automation (pseudo)
if metric('error_rate') > 0.015 or metric('p95_delta') > 0.30:
  api.post('/admin/flags/route_by_cost_v2/rollback')
  notify('#eng-platform', 'rollback applied by dead-man switch')
```
Mira: Can we also add a 'quiet period' metric smoothing to avoid flapping? e.g., require violation for 2 consecutive 5min buckets.
Lex: +1. Also capture user-facing impact: logits drop or rerank errors. Add `quality.regression.percent` to gate.
Cam: OK seems actionable. Jira created: PLATFORM-3482. I'll schedule 10% canary tomorrow. Please add dashboard panels and a test alert channel `#rollouts-staging`.
Tara: :thumbsup: I'll add the workspace-level approval step for Dedicated customers.
Jasper: I'll merge the cache invalidation patch and add an integration test for quota atomocity.
Cam: Thanks all — pushing the rollout checklist to the console draft now.
